visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outside a bright airport terminal in natural daylight, a man wearing a yellow cap, glasses, and a blue striped denim jacket pulls a black suitcase. He stops and opens his gray backpack, causing over a dozen brown leather wallets to spill onto the stone-tiled floor. He looks surprised with his mouth slightly open. (2) The man stands before the airport entrance, holding up travel essentials: a green passport, a black power bank, and a small blue pack of Tempo wet wipes. He smiles directly at the camera, gesturing with the items in his hands. The lighting is bright and even. (3) A series of close-up shots show the man cleaning his neck with a wet wipe, then using it to wipe the toe of his black sandals, and finally cleaning a silver spoon. The packaging is detailed with blue and white colors and a Miffy rabbit illustration. (4) The man sits on a brown park bench surrounded by various blue Tempo products including tissue boxes and wipe packs. He holds a Miffy-branded pack close to the lens. The background shows green trees and a blurred street. (5) In the final scene, the man is seen crouching on the pavement back at the airport, quickly picking up the scattered wallets and stuffing them back into his backpack. He has a focused and slightly embarrassed expression, wearing a black backpack and a blue jacket.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A casual conversation begins with a curious female voice and a male voice responding. A series of mid-frequency, percussive thuds occur as objects hit the stone floor. Bright, upbeat electronic BGM with a strong 4/4 drum beat and synth chords starts. (2) The male voice transitions into a high-arousal, rapid-fire promotional delivery. The BGM remains consistent in its poppy, high-energy texture. Short transients of plastic rustling are audible. (3) The narration continues with high articulation clarity and rising intonation for emphasis. The BGM tempo remains steady. No significant acoustic environmental noise interferes with the speech. (4) A friendly, persuasive tone is used to describe product benefits and a giveaway. The BGM swells slightly in the mix with a bright spectral profile. (5) The BGM cuts out, replaced by several quick, dry clicking and shuffling sounds. The male voice delivers a final, low-arousal humorous line before the audio ends.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Revelation -> Product Education -> Call to Action -> Comedic Resolution.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a commercial endorsement for Tempo wet wipes. It utilizes a comedic 'unboxing' hook where the creator drops dozens of wallets to grab attention, then transitions into an educational segment highlighting the product's safety for sensitive skin and its high-quality ingredients (RO water, Alpine water). It concludes with a promotional giveaway to drive audience engagement.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, verbal recommendation of brand features, and a structured giveaway activity.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully blends influencer-style comedy with professional product marketing, using high-paced editing to maintain viewer interest.
